verses.text: Here’s how Israel’s people received their land in Canaan: Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the family leaders of Israel’s tribes divided it up for them, 📜
handing out each inheritance by lot, just as Yahweh had commanded through Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe. 🎲
Moses had already allotted land east of the Jordan to two full tribes and half of another. But he didn’t give the Levites a land share among them. 🗺️
Joseph’s descendants counted as two tribes—Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave the Levites no land portion, just towns to live in and pastureland for their livestock and belongings. 🐑
Israel did exactly what Yahweh had commanded Moses and divided up the land. ✅
Then Judah’s people came to Joshua at Gilgal. Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite told him, ‘You know what Yahweh said to Moses, the man of God, about you and me at Kadesh-barnea. 🗣️
‘I was forty when Moses, Yahweh’s servant, sent me from Kadesh-barnea to scout the land. I came back and gave him the report exactly as I saw it. 🕵️
‘The other men who went with me scared everybody and melted their courage. But I stayed all-in with Yahweh my God. 💪
‘That day Moses swore, “The land your feet walked on will belong to you and your children forever, because you stayed fully loyal to Yahweh my God.” 👣
‘Now look—Yahweh kept me alive just as he said. It’s been forty-five years since Yahweh told Moses that, while Israel was wandering in the wilderness. And here I am today, eighty-five years old. 🎂
‘I’m still as strong now as I was the day Moses sent me. I’ve got the same strength for battle, for heading out and coming back. 💪

‘So give me this hill country Yahweh promised that day. You heard then that the Anakim were there, with huge fortified cities. Maybe Yahweh will be with me, and I’ll drive them out, just as he said.’ 🏔️
Joshua blessed Caleb and gave Hebron to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his inheritance. 🙏
That’s how Hebron became Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite’s inheritance, still to this day, because he followed Yahweh, Israel’s God, with his whole heart. 🤝
Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, named after the greatest man among the Anakim. After that, the land had a break from war. 🕊️
